tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250re manta'i skong gsol cang shes char 'beb yod/1$0000300 hūm̐/ 'gro ba kun la brtse ba'i shākya thub// byang chub sems dpa' cang shes nyi ma'i snying*/ khro rgyal rta mchog padma he ru ka /rta drel rngog chags skyabs phyir gshegs su gsol// nyi ma'i sras po 'phags pa re manta// rang 'dra lnga brgya'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// rta drel rngog chags 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phyir// thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ma hā kā la rta nag rting dkar can// sems dpa' rnam thos sras dang gang ba bzang*// rta yi srung ma gnod sbyin ku be ra// rngog chags bsrung phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// pad zla nyi ma dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan// cang shes rgyan ldan la sogs khri steng du// dgyes shing brtan pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tiṣṭha lhan/ hūm̐/ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das rta lha'i tshogs/ khyed rnams mchod cing thugs dam bskang ba ni// 'bru bzang bshos gtsang bdud rtsi skyems phud bran// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te// kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar mchod pa'i sprin// chu bzhi nyer spyod lnga dang 'dod yon lnga// ngo mtshar mchod pa bco brgyad rgyal srid bdun// gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla bye ba brgya// lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod dpag med rnams// blo yis blang dang yid kyis rnam sprul te// bcom ldan shākya seng ge'i thugs dam bskang*// cang shes nyi ma'i snying po'i thugs= gsang mchog gzungs sngags rnams kyi thugs= khyed kyi thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas// bdag gi rta drel rngog chags thams cad la// tshad med thugs rjes rtag tu srung skyob mdzod// sman raka gtor ma phyi nang gsang mchod tshogs// rig ma bcu drug lta spyod ting 'dzin gyis// bcom ldan khro rgyal rta mgrin thugs dam bskang*/ khyed kyi thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas// bdag gi rta drel rngog chags thams cad kyi// lus ngag yid gsum srung zhing skyob pa dang*// gnod byed btsan sri'i gnod pa zlog pa dang*// rngog chags rnams kyi gnod byed tshar chod cig

/gtor ma 'bru sman rin chen dar zab dang*// shel rmog bse khrab ba dan lce brgyad dang*// ral gri 'khor lo rdo rje mda' dar dang*// rta sngon ngang pa spu mdzes rgyan ldan pa// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te// rdo rje re manta yi thugs dam bskang*// dpal rab 'chang ba'i mgon po'i thugs= ārya re manta yi thugs= gzhon nu nyi ma'i sras po'i thugs= khro chen re manta yi thugs= rang 'dra'i 'khor tshogs lnga brgya'i thugs= steng na lding ba khyung gi thugs= logs na 'jum pa bya khra'i thugs= mdun na 'gro ba stag mo'i thugs= rgyab na 'gying ba seng chen thugs= 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs gyur nas// bdag gi rta drel rngog chags thams cad kun// dus rnams kun tu srung zhing skyob pa dang*// 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol// sdom lheb la gar grang ba chu 'gags sogs// rta nad 'tsher rtsub thams cad zlog tu gsol// glo bur dgra rkun rta 'dre rtil sri rnams// bskrad dang bcing dang gsod pa'i phrin las mdzod// dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bru sman rin chen dang*// sngon po chu ris dar sna'i rgyal mtshan sogs// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te// rdo rje rnam thos sras po'i thugs dam bskang*// gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po'i thugs dam bskang*// 'khor bcas thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas// bdag gi rta drel rngog chags thams cad kun// 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol// zhon pas phongs dang dbul dang rgud pa rnams// thams cad zlogs shig sgyur cig zhi bar mdzod// god 'dre ltog 'gong dbul sri tshar chod cig /bshos bu skyems phud 'bru sna dar tshon dang*// rta nag rting dkar 'jol ber ral gri dang*// ru mtshon la sogs dngos 'byor yid sprul gyis// lha chen ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*// rta nag rting dkar 'chibs pa'i thugs=

nyi zla skar chen 'phro ba'i thugs= rta bdag ku be ra yi thugs= rang 'dra'i sprul pa 'bum gyi thugs= khyed kyi thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas// bdag gi rta drel rngog chags thams cad kun// srung zhing skyob pa'i rdzi bo khyod la bcol// sngon gyi dam tshig thugs dam dran mdzod la// gzhi byes lam gsum kun tu srung skyob mdzod// rngog chags rnams la gnod pa thams cad zlogs// rta 'dre btsan sri gnod byed tshar chod cig /shāka thub sems dpa' cang shes nyi ma'i snying*// rta mgrin re manta dang rnam thos sras// mgon po ku be ra rnams bdag la dgongs// thog med dus nas da lta yan chad du// zhon pa phongs pa'i sgrib pa ci bsags pa// mgon po khyed rnams spyan sngar 'gyod pas bshags// phyin chad mi bgyid legs par sdom lags kyis// sngon bsags las sgrib byang bar byin gyis rlobs// mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub myur du stsol// rkang bzhi rngog chags 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /oṃ sa ma ya/ āḥs ma ya/ hūm̐ sa ma ya/ oṃ ārya re manta swā hā/ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya

nas satwa āḥ lha rnams nongs pa gang mchis bzod par gsol// rang gnas gshegs sam rten la ci bder bzhugs// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dge legs tshogs// gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog / ces brjod do// 'di bris nyes pa mchis na rta lha'i tshogs la bshags/ dge bas 'gro kun rta mchog 'grub par shog /ces a rā gas sbyar ba maṅga laṃ/// /
